summary: Kinross Gold Corp filed a Form 6-K reporting a press release declaring a quarterly dividend of US$0.04 per common share for Q1 2026. The dividend is payable on June 4, 2026, to shareholders of record on May 21, 2026. This is a routine capital return to shareholders, reflecting the company's ongoing dividend policy. The filing is a foreign private issuer report (Form 6-K) that announces a regular dividend declaration, qualifying as an eligible dividend under Canadian tax rules. No special situation such as a tender, spin-off, or restructuring is present. The event is a straightforward dividend declaration with no unusual terms or strategic implications. Watch for any future changes to the dividend policy or special dividends.
